title: Identify schools where more than 10% of K–12 students are eligible for free
question: Identify schools where more than 10% of K–12 students are eligible for free meals and the total SAT score (sum of average reading, math, and writing) is below 1500. Return the school name, county, full physical address (street, city, state, zip), and excellence rate (NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr).

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_045 AS county,
    s.XCL_048 AS street,
    s.XCL_050 AS city,
    s.XCL_052 AS state,
    s.XCL_051 AS zip,
    CAST(sat.XCL_040 AS REAL) / sat.XCL_036 AS excellence_rate
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
INNER JOIN satscores AS sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
WHERE
    (f.XCL_020 * 100.0 / f.XCL_019) > 10
    AND (sat.XCL_037 + sat.XCL_038 + sat.XCL_039) < 1500

    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_045 AS county,
    s.XCL_048 AS street,
    s.XCL_050 AS city,
    s.XCL_052 AS state,
    s.XCL_051 AS zip,
    CAST(sat.XCL_040 AS REAL) / sat.XCL_036 AS excellence_rate
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001

    (f.XCL_020 * 100.0 / f.XCL_019) > 10
